name: Realtor.com
positioning: The portal operated under licence from the National Association of REALTORS, fed directly by MLS data.
description: Realtor.com is a consumer portal whose distinguishing claim is data freshness: listings come from MLS feeds under an NAR operating agreement rather than from scraped or syndicated sources. Its professional side sells Connections Plus and Market Reach advertising, and it owns rental products including Avail.
real_estate_use: Agents buy exclusive or shared buyer leads by ZIP code and use the platform's listing presence as a seller-pitch argument. Because the feed comes from the MLS, status changes propagate faster than on aggregators, which matters when a client is comparing what is actually still available.
features: Connections Plus buyer lead products by ZIP code
Market Reach display advertising to a farm area
RealEstimate valuation range from multiple models
Rental products including Avail for small landlords

use_cases.job: Acquire buyer leads in a defined ZIP code with MLS-accurate inventory behind them
Show a seller the reach their listing gets across the portal network
